title: Monotonicity of bar-weight under coprime bar-core reduction
author: Dean Yates
difficulty_reason: After ordinary partition, bar-core and Coxeter-group prerequisites, the authored proof still designs a residue-controlled sequence of paired bead moves and counts bar-weight pairs through all degenerate and nondegenerate residue cases.
